name: KC Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1987 and headquartered in Anseong, South Korea, KC Co., Ltd. is a global developer and supplier of advanced systems for the semiconductor and display industries, alongside specialized electronic materials. The company's semiconductor portfolio includes chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) tools and sophisticated wet cleaning apparatus. For display fabrication, it offers a range of equipment such as wet station systems, atmospheric pressure plasma cleaners, CO2 cleaning units, and coater and track systems, essential for producing LCD, LTPS, OLED, and flexible panels. Furthermore, KC Co., Ltd. furnishes critical electronic materials, including dielectric and metal slurries, as well as various additives.
